parameters.name: DedicatedHostClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated host cluster.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostIds
parameters.description: The list of dedicated host IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: DedicatedHostName
parameters.description: The name of the dedicated host.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostType
parameters.description: The type of the dedicated host. You can call [DescribeDedicatedHostTypes](~~134240~~) to query the most recent list of dedicated host types.

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description:
The reason why the dedicated host is locked. Valid values:
- financial: The dedicated host is locked due to an overdue payment.
- security: The dedicated host is locked for security reasons.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. If you set this parameter, the MaxResults and NextToken parameters are used together for paging.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform paged query operations for paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform paged query operations for paging.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the dedicated host belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

> Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

parameters.name: SocketDetails
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display socket-level capacity information. You can use socket-level capacity information to view remaining resources (vCPUs, memory usage, remaining capacity, and total capacity) to determine whether an ECS instance of a specific instance type can be created. Valid values:

- true: Displays socket-level capacity information. Only specific dedicated host types support displaying socket-level resource information. For more information, see [View and export DDH information](~~68989~~).
- false: Does not display socket-level capacity information.

><notice>

Each dedicated host typically has two CPUs, numbered Socket 0 and Socket 1. On a dedicated host, ECS instances are not created across sockets to ensure maximum performance. An ECS instance is created based on a single socket only.

- If the remaining computing resources of one socket are greater than or equal to the ECS instance type to be created, the ECS instance is created.
- If the remaining computing resources of each socket are less than the ECS instance type to be created, the ECS instance fails to be created, even if the combined remaining resources of both sockets exceed the ECS instance type requirements.
</notice>

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The usage status of the dedicated host. Valid values:

- Available: The dedicated host is running as expected.

- UnderAssessment: The physical machine has potential risks. The physical machine is available but may cause issues for ECS instances on the dedicated host.

- PermanentFailure: The dedicated host has a permanent failure and is unavailable.

- TempUnavailable: The dedicated host is temporarily unavailable.

- Redeploying: The dedicated host is being restored.

Default value: Available.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the dedicated host. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the dedicated host. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the most recent zone list.
